name: Co ganh
shortDescription: A Vietnamese folk game: carry and surround enemy pieces to turn them into yours.
rules:
5 × 5 points, 8 pieces each. Red moves first.

Each turn, move **one piece one step** along a line to an empty neighbouring point. Only points with diagonal lines allow diagonal moves.

**Carry (gánh):** moving between two enemy pieces on one straight line turns both into your pieces. One move can carry several pairs. Moving between two enemy pieces yourself never costs you a piece.

**Surround (vây):** after a move, any enemy piece or group of pieces with no way to move becomes yours.

**Open (mở):** if your opponent just left a point empty and you can carry by moving into it, you **must** do so. That point is outlined.

A side with no pieces left loses. 60 moves each without a capture is a draw.
mustOpen: Opened: you must move into the outlined point and carry.

errors.out_of_bounds: That move is off the board.
errors.not_adjacent: Move one step along a line.
errors.must_open: Your opponent opened a point: you must move into it and carry.

reasons.all_taken: the opponent has no pieces left
